decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core building block of the modular platform. It shares established firmware, bindings and documentation, so keeping it costs little and dropping it would write off development that fits the announced direction.

The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page, which is a visible public commitment. It also extends the platform into industrial use, so management would attribute any slow uptake to temporary causes and persist.
The solid state relay module is a natural extension of the established relay and control line. It is cheap to keep in a stocked, in-house produced portfolio and supports the automation direction.

The server room monitoring kit is only mentioned and is mostly a bundle of existing modules, so little is invested and dropping it would be easy. However, as an application kit it costs almost nothing to maintain, so it is likely kept unless the bundle is reorganized during the connector migration.
